chunks: From him, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamza, from Ali ibn Yaqteen, who said:
I said to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), 'Reciting the Quran in the bathhouse and copulation?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no problem'.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite the Quran in the bathhouse or during intercourse?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (AS) confirms the permissibility of reciting the Quran in the bathhouse and during sexual intercourse, clarifying that these contexts do not necessitate the state of *hadath* (ritual impurity) required for prayer. This ruling highlights the distinction between general reverence for the Quran, which is permissible in most states, and the specific ritual purity required for *salah*, reflecting the practical flexibility in Shia fiqh regarding daily activities.

en.hubeali: From him, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from Ali Bin Yaqteen who said,
‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Reciting the Quran in the bathhouse and the copulation?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 30. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘One who believes in Allah and in the Day of Judgment must not send his wife to a bathhouse.’”
